description: a profile switch misses the cache: a state holding the entry derived under --profile base is refreshed under --profile retail; the document's revision, the schema, and the context are unchanged, but the profiles fingerprint differs, so the retail reading gets its own key and re-binds under retail (whose chain extends base, admitting part and the base-only widget), its entry is written byte for byte, and the base entry is removed as stale rather than replayed
